title: Sonatina in C major, first movement
short: Muzio Clementi · C 2/2 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: A sonatina is a short sonata, and this is one of the first that piano students learn. Listen for the opening tune: it comes back near the end, an octave lower. Count two half-note beats in each bar (cut time) and keep the scales even.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: Sonatina Op. 36 No. 1 (published 1797): first movement

sources.name: Mutopia Project edition (Brian D. Rude, from the G. Schirmer Sonatina Album, 1893; public domain), compared with this file note by note by our checking script. That edition prints no dynamics in this movement, only the word Spiritoso. Date from Wikipedia.
